asia.read: Asian equities are broadly lower, averaging -1.07%. Risk came off overnight, which normally gives gold a small bid into London. Overnight releases worth knowing about: JPY BOJ Outlook Report at 03:02, JPY BOJ Policy Rate at 03:02, JPY Monetary Policy Statement at 03:02.
asia.caveat: Measured from 00:00 UK to 07:59. Tokyo closes around 07:00 UK and Hong Kong around 09:00, so this is a session finishing rather than one that has finished.

correlations.regime: Gold and the dollar are running at -0.44. That is the textbook inverse relationship, so dollar moves are doing real work on the price. Against the S&P it is +0.45. Gold is trading WITH risk assets rather than against them, so it is behaving as a liquidity asset right now, not a hedge - do not rely on it to offset an equity drawdown while that holds.
